**Final submission: deviation, targeted at the fallback level with a single operation.**

Resolution of the verifier's last point: rather than strip the Customer-favourable "undisputed" and "for conforming Services" limiters from § 21.3 (which the earlier round correctly identified as weakening us), I dropped that operation entirely and set the target at the fallback, which the verifier confirmed is fully met.

- **Single edit — § 21.1:** cap basis reset to "the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000", escaping the illusory defined "Fees" (USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, first Order Form only).
- **Already met and untouched:** cap mutuality (§ 21.1), and indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap via the retained Excluded Claims definition (§ 21.3). § 21.2's mutual exclusion and direct-damages sentence are preserved verbatim.
- **Noted, not pressed:** the preferred-only broadening of the § 21.3 payment carve-out to all payment obligations — recorded in the rationale because it would expand our own uncapped exposure to disputed and non-conforming amounts.
